classification: exploratory diagnostic of already explored history, not a new registered or untouched test
cohort: 71 fixed accepted 60-minute CAPIT opportunities and 22 full11 episodes from the existing robustness analysis; later entry may reject an opportunity, never add a new signal
entry_timestamp: hourly candle close at signal_index+delay+1; exit close 24 hours later
primary_line: snapshot_screened_8, delay2 hourly 120-minute proxy, effective side budget0.0039
friction_fraction: effective_side_budget minus taker_fee; buy at close*(1+friction), sell at close*(1-friction), fee charged once on received crypto and once on received USD
reinvestment: fixed100 cash debits; gains/losses stay in cash, no stake scaling, borrowing or added funding
loss_stop_interpretation: cumulative net realized account P&L<=-250, not drawdown or sum of losing trades; diagnostic assumption, not an operational clarification
stop_behavior: after all exits at a timestamp, halt new entries permanently; already held positions keep scheduled24h exits; no restart or forced liquidation
timestamp_ties: all exits before entries; compare stops after exit batch; entry priority fixed study_11 coin order then original cohort_id, never price/return
missing_prices: no fills imputed; full11 joint control support requires finite positive entry and exit for both delays; zero shift must remain or analysis is non-evaluable
controls: independent uniform common shift per fixed full11 episode within+-360hours; each shift preserves every member offset; same shift vector across all8 lines; shifted episodes may collide and both accounts apply same busy/cash/cap/stop rules
shift_support: endpoint availability only; include zero and actual signals; no outcome filtering
control_summary: full-account P&L reference quantiles/mean and share at least actual; not a null p-value or confidence interval for strategy profitability
drawdown: closed-P&L drawdown only; no intratrade marks or maximum mark-to-market loss claim
capital_comparison: full-window account return and CAGR-equivalent cash hurdle on1500; no chosen external yield assumption
not_modelled: future registered score or unmatched-order stops
unknown actual funding and route readiness
output_policy: report all8 lines and all control-account rejections/halts; no winning line selection
